# Validate model argument

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?checkModel`</small>

Checks that `model` is of class `lm` or `glm`. With `enhanced = TRUE` it
also runs the soft checks of the deprecated `checkModelEnhanced()`: it warns
when the residual degrees of freedom fall below six, when a near-perfect fit
is detected (R\(^2 > 0.999\)), or, when `data` is given, when a variance
inflation factor exceeds 10 (Belsley et al., 1980).

## Usage

```r
checkModel(model, data = NULL, enhanced = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   An object to check.

`data`
:   Optional `data.frame` used when fitting `model`. With
    `enhanced = TRUE` it enables the multicollinearity check through
    [`performVIFDiagnostic()`](performVIFDiagnostic.md).

`enhanced`
:   Logical. `FALSE`, the default, checks the class only.

## Value

Invisible `model` if valid, otherwise an error is thrown.

## References

Belsley, D. A., Kuh, E., & Welsch, R. E. (1980). *Regression Diagnostics:
Identifying Influential Data and Sources of Collinearity*. Wiley.
